release_notes:
• Playback Engine Stability: Expanded cache buffer to 512 MB with 30-minute protection, preventing abrupt playback halts after 2–3 songs
• Seamless Repeat Mode: Tracks loop continuously when repeat is enabled without stream or buffer exhaustion
• Live Playlist Sync: Track highlights and playing equalizer indicators update instantly when tracks change in playlists, collections, and search
• Quick Spatial 8D & Shuffle: Added 8D Audio button and Shuffle controls directly to Home featured cards and Android Lock Screen / Notification bar
• Full-Screen Minimal Updater: Redesigned in-app update experience with clean flat surfaces, full changelog viewer, and zero glow or neon effects
